subject: Math
subskill: Word Problem - Setup and Solve Inequality
prompt: A student club needs to collect at least $250$ canned food items for a food drive. If the club has already collected $138$ canned food items, what is the minimum number of additional canned food items the club needs to collect to reach its goal?
explanation: Choice B is correct. Let $x$ represent the number of additional canned food items the club needs to collect. After collecting $x$ more items, the club will have a total of $138 + x$ items. Because the club needs at least $250$ items, $138 + x \geq 250$. Subtracting $138$ from both sides yields $x \geq 112$. Therefore, the minimum number of additional canned food items the club needs to collect is $112$.
